newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait crown prince in hospital, in good condition.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait crown prince in hospital, in good condition.

text.p: Kuwaiti Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah was taken to hospital for medical tests following a sudden health problem, an official said on Tuesday.
"Thank God he is in good condition," said an official who accompanied Sheikh Saad to hospital. He refused to say what the crown prince, born in 1930, was suffering from.

The emiri court earlier on Tuesday issued a statement on the official Kuwaiti news agency (KUNA) telling citizens that Sheikh Saad's condition was "extremely reassuring" after suffering a "sudden indisposition".
Sheikh Saad, chosen to succeed Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah, was reappointed prime minister last October following parliamentary elections.
Kuwait, a welfare state of some 720,000 Kuwaitis and more than a million foreigners, controls 10 percent of the world's proven oil reserves.
Sheikh Saad has been holding the post of prime minister since he was made crown prince in 1978.
